title: Normative whole-body standing sagittal alignment (head to feet), healthy Japanese adults
condition: in vivo, relaxed standing, hands on cheeks, horizontal gaze (mirror)

quantity.name: standing sagittal alignment parameters
quantity.definition: radiographic angles/distances in the sagittal plane: Cobb-type kyphosis/lordosis, SS, PT, PI, TPA, SVA (+ = forward), CAM-GL (force-plate gravity line), SFA, knee/ankle flexion (+ = flexion)

source.authors: Hasegawa K, Okamoto M, Hatsushikano S, Shimoda H, Ono M, Watanabe K
source.sample: 126 healthy volunteers (30 M, 96 F); Japanese adult volunteers without spinal disease (136 enrolled; 10 excluded for transitional vertebrae/11 thoracic vertebrae/scoliosis >20 deg)

protocol.summary: EOS slot-scanning whole-body biplanar X-ray from acoustic meati to feet while standing on a force plate (gravity line).
how_to_use: Set a standing reference posture for a whole-body/spine model: T1-T12 kyphosis ~41.5 deg, L1-S1 lordosis ~55 deg (L1-L5 ~40 deg), SS ~41 deg, PT ~11.5 deg, PI ~52 deg, SVA ~0 cm, knees ~straight.
Make the posture age-specific with the regressions (PT, PI, SVA, knee flexion increase with age).
Pick a lordosis consistent with the subject's PI and age using the ideal-LL formula; vary within +-1 SD (or IQR) for robustness runs.
Cohort is 76% female and Japanese: check against Mac-Thiong 2011 / Vialle 2005 (Caucasian, balanced sex) before generalising.

measurement.device: EOS slot-scanning X-ray (whole body) + force plate (ANIMA) for gravity line
measurement.posture: standing comfortably, hands on cheeks, horizontal gaze aided by mirror

equations: Ideal LL = 8.88 - 0.08*age - 0.86*sex - 0.82*SVA - 0.56*(C2-7 lordosis) + 0.45*Kyph - 0.09*PI + 1.12*SS - 0.89*PTh - 0.14*AnkleFlex (sex: 0 male, 1 female; R=0.9701)
protocol.notes: '?' and '9' glyphs in the PDF text are '+' and 'x'; signs verified by plugging the cohort mean age/PI (e.g. PT(39.4)=10.9 vs 11.5; LL=55.2 vs 55.4). Positive correlation with age also for McGS (R=0.328) and T1-12 kyphosis (R=0.207), no regression equation given. C2-7 lordosis row (0.2, -4.5/4.8, SD 2.0, IQR -1.1/1.5) is nearly identical to the CAM-GL row; possible copy error in the source table - transcribed as printed. No sex-specific alignment values reported.

extraction.check_notes: All 16 rows re-read from layout text (mean, min/max, SD, SE, IQR 25/75). Equations checked against cohort means.

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
